methodology.categoryReference: Saved labels excluding Uncategorized; posts without topic labels are excluded, not treated as negatives. Extra labels measure disagreement, not necessarily editorial mistakes.
methodology.calibration: 148 tuning articles (133 category-labelled), with 20 separate development controls protecting central subjects. 295 non-holdout posts supply usage priors; prompt example titles exclude both tuning and reserved articles. F0.5 prioritizes precision; fitting weights decay with a three-year half-life.
methodology.validation: 66 articles reserved from fitting; 63 have category labels. They were previously included in the original baseline and evaluated twice during this revision. The first policy was rejected after separate development regressions; no final thresholds were fitted to these 66 labels. This is reused validation, not a new untouched test set.
methodology.temporalScope: Retrospective random-partition validation, not a forward-in-time test: category definitions and non-holdout usage counts span the five-year snapshot. Fitting downweights older labels rather than assuming category usage stayed fixed.
methodology.upgrades: Publication-date replay filters available offers. Current frontmatter ScalingFast labels predating its article-offer launch are backfills and excluded from date-aware accuracy. Missing values and legacy offers remain separate. The old baseline had no availability gate; the publication-era heuristic is also shown to expose class/era confounding.
methodology.availabilityEvidence: swizec.com commit 8557ae475bea49eddcf416f1fb8b9a1d4cb2aaae on 2025-12-07 added the standard ScalingFast article upgrade; the book announcement was published 2025-12-08. A landing-page signup existed earlier, from 2025-09-17.
methodology.inputs: Only title and full Markdown body are model input. Publication date controls the book choices; saved labels and URLs do not enter the request.

signature.upgradePolicy: Offer only books available on the publication date; dates and labels are not model input.

calibration.method: smoothed archive-prior odds; constrained F0.5 grid search; article-level five-fold cross-validation
